lines.text:
So, the Ark is humanity's final stronghold.
Sounds similar to the Colony where we're from.
Fortunately, our weapons can take down Raptures, so we'll be able to help.

There doesn't seem to be any obvious physical disparity between Nikkes and humans.
How do you tell them apart?

Looks like we're both in very similar situations.
Let's stay strong and hang in there together.
Why do I work as hard as I do? Perhaps because I believe it's the right thing to do.
You don't always need a reason to help people.
Wouldn't it be better to move, even a little, rather than just standing around like this?

The music here isn't too bad either. 
Take your time—I'll just be here enjoying it.

So this is the Outpost.
May I take a look around?

This place is quite impressive.
I can't believe it's entirely underground.

There's a waterfall underground? 
Incredible.

EVE from the Airborne Squad.
I will be joining you for a brief moment.

I can feel my strength surging through me.
What a familiar sensation.
It's fascinating. Who knew I could be this strong.

I feel good.
It's making me want to move around.

Looks like a classified package, hidden under some kind of... camouflage?
But for camouflage... isn't this a bit too flashy?

Thanks.
I will make sure to repay this kindness.

I don't have anything to give you in return,
so I will do my utmost to be of assistance.

You seem pretty used to strangers like us. 
Thank you for being so welcoming.

Being a Commander must be tough,
having to spin so many plates at once.

You all seem like good people.
I don't regret helping you one bit.
I'm ready to fight anytime.
I'm here.
I'll go over there.
Engaging the enemy.
Let's begin.
I'll do my best.
So these are the enemies of this world...
Reloading.
I'm out of ammo.
I'll join you soon, hang on.
Going in for close combat!
Let's finish this in one fell swoop!
This is it! Press the attack!
Got them.
I'll keep moving.
Good.
Ugh...!
Urgh...!
I'm sorry, but I have to fall back!
All clear. Where do we go next?

Living here isn't so bad.
The learning curve isn't too steep, and I think I'm adapting quite well.

If I ever get the chance, I'd like to visit this place you call the Ark.
I'm curious what it's like over there.

You say these Raptures are infinite in number?
... I see you suffer from that problem in this world as well.

I'm starting to get used to this place. 
Maybe that's because it's not so different from our world?

There are ten million people left in the Ark?
That is a large enough number to dream of hope.
If the Raptures are infinite in number, then drastic measures must be taken to turn the tide.
Are you going to be away for long?
Is it all right if I take a look around while I'm waiting?

This place is very much its own self-contained miniature world.
While it may be diminutive, it has everything you need.

Why are there no humans living here? 
... Ah, so Raptures attack this place on occasion.

I don't mean to be a busybody, but you might want to consider fixing the elevator.
It rattles too much.

If you need me, call me anytime.
I want to repay you for all your help.

I'm overflowing with firepower.
I feel like I can do anything.
I think it'll be possible to fight more efficiently.

I will be right back.
There is a move I want to try.

What clever camouflage... oh, wait, it's gift wrapping?
Hehe, well then, I'll be gentle when I open it. Thanks.

Do you need anything?
Is there anything I can help with?

Is this how you use it...?
No... At any rate, I'll figure it out.
Your squadmates are so full of energy. It's nice to see.

You're a good person, Commander.
Keep doing what you're doing.
If I had more time, I think your squad and ours would have made a great team.
Roger. Heading in.
Where should I go?
I'll take lead.
Let's go, everyone.
We've got the drop on them.
Position check. Let's go.
This won't be a challenge.
Cover me.
Reloading.
Pulling back for a moment.
This is our chance!
This is my territory!
Let's keep the momentum going!
I've got them.
Target down. Next.
Let's continue.
Tsk!
Ugh...!
No way...!
The rest is up to you...
Good teamwork, everyone. Let's keep it up.
This is the first time I've been able to relax like this.

A bit of R&R is nice, but one must never forget their duty.
If there's anything you need, be sure to call me.
Hmm... Is it all right for me to be sitting around like this?

Would you like to sit beside me? 
It's nice and cool over here.
So this is what it feels like to have time off. It's nice.
I might as well rest while I have the chance and worry about the rest later.
Where did you go? It's a bit awkward relaxing on my own.
All right. Since I'm already here, I'll be patient and wait.
This place is quite well-made. It's a great place for walks.
I've never been to a place with such hustle and bustle. How fun!
I wonder if there are any fish in the pool here... Probably not, right?

I'm resting because I was told to...
But I wonder if I'm resting properly.
Even when I'm supposed to be resting, I must keep up my training.

I need to prepare for the big battle ahead.
Resting is part of that preparation.

All right, that should be enough.
I'm ready to set out anytime.

Thank you.
I'm sorry for always taking and never giving anything back.
I will treasure this.

Let me know if there is something you want.
I will do my utmost to obtain it.
Come and sit for a while before you go.

I never thought I would get to experience a world like this.
There is much to think about even after I return.
Would you like something to drink?
A battle? I'll get ready.
This is it.
I think it's this way.
Engaging the enemy.
I need to loosen up. I'm a bit stiff.
Work hard, play hard.
Time to resume my regular duties.
I'll join you shortly.
Oh no, the bullets...
I've gotten a bit rusty.
Whew... I'm tired.
Resting isn't so bad.
Break time's over! Let's go!
Good.
Not bad.
Target eliminated.
Ugh...!
I let my guard down...!
... Looks like I relaxed too much. Sorry.
When can we rest again?
